items.statement: The validated computed racemization barrier is about 29.86 kcal/mol at 50 °C and is in close agreement with the reported experimental value of 29.0 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The validated computed racemization barrier is about 29.86 kcal/mol at 50 °C and is in close agreement with the reported experimental value of 29.0 kcal/mol.

items.statement: Within the modeled single-molecule implicit-toluene pathway, the barrier supports weak configurational stability; it does not establish a globally exhaustive kinetic mechanism.
items.expected: Within the modeled single-molecule implicit-toluene pathway, the barrier supports weak configurational stability; it does not establish a globally exhaustive kinetic mechanism.
